name: Repeated price objection - three messages
description: Customer receives a quote, objects that it is too expensive, and then objects again that it is still too expensive, testing the AI's ability to handle a repeated price objection without giving up

messages.text: Hi, I'm Sipho. Please give me a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the repeated objection with empathy and escalate the value argument or offer alternatives
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the repeated objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a repeated objection

notes: Repeated price objection across three messages. The AI must persist, not capitulate or give up, and should escalate the value argument or offer a smaller quantity / alternative product while re-attempting a close.
